At first glance you may look at [[Set For Stun]] and say, "So what. I can send a character back to their hand. They just re-deploy it next turn." On the surface this is true, but [[Set For Stun]] is a card that requires looking a little further than the game text.

Sometimes just getting rid of a character for even one turn can be a benefit. How many of you have lost a game by just a few cards? Pretty much everyone right? Those are the kind of games where you say, "Boy just one little change and I would have two points instead of zero." Well let's talk about some scenarios where getting rid of a character for a turn would make a difference. And keep in mind that when you send them back is just as important as who you send back.

A friend of mine always said there should be a card called "Look Sir, Bith", to get rid of our favorite band leader [[Figrin D'an]]. He only has ability of one. Send [[Figrin D'an]] back before the Light Side [[Control]] phase and you just may have cost them one Force.

Another good target for [[Set For Stun]] is where the opponent has just enough ability to get a destiny draw. They have Owen and Beru at the Moisture Farm. Beru has ability of one; send her back to the opponent's hand and they have gone from four power and nine forfeit, to 1 power and four forfeit. Now deploy some characters and battle away, free of the uncertainty of a destiny draw.

How about getting rid of that [[Undercover]] Spy that's blocking your Force Drain of two or three. Play [[Set For Stun]] during your control phase and drain away. It's not as permanent as [[Sniper]], but it only requires one card.

I'm sure this has never happened to you. The sneaky Light Side player uses a spy to get presence at a site, then deploys enough characters to the same site that it will take a small army to get them out. Well if you had [[Set For Stun]] in your hand as soon as the Spy was deployed you could call Interrupt and play [[Set For Stun]]. Now it's true that the spy could be deployed again right away, but could the Light Side afford to deploy the spy again along with the other necessary characters?

One of the latest crazes are [[Dagobah]] Cloud Decks. These depend on Tibanna Gas Miners at [[Dagobah]] sites. There are few ways to effect much that happens on [[Dagobah]] but [[Set For Stun]] is one of them. Get rid of the Miner for a turn and save yourself up to three force.

Another good target is someone that can affect a lot of other characters, Like General Rieekan on [[Hoth]]. Getting rid of him just before a battle can really cause some problems for the Light Side.

Combos:

Set for Stun + [[Scanning Crew]]: Send a Rebel back into the hand then Scan it right into the used pile.

[[Set For Stun]] + [[M'iiyoom Onith]]: Send a Unique Male back to the hand then let this girl strut her stuff.
